design_note: Step 0 design round, 2026-10-07. Source: toll-kits branch claude/pensive-brahmagupta-8yv4rd, brainstorm/batra-design-lock.md and batra-lora-brief.md (his decisions 2026-10-02; small details delegated to Claude and he can change any). Age 26, 6'1", bulky, full medium-full black beard, kesari turban (compact, close-fitting, crossed front folds, NO emblem), steel kada on the RIGHT wrist, gold bracer on the LEFT, forearm sleeves, kesari primary and black secondary, no scar, no kirpan, no bead necklace. Respect the turban: always a neatly wound turban, never a hat or cap, never knocked off, burning or mocked; no fire in the base design. His real-life reference photos stay out of the repos and out of training. The identity prompt is Claude's draft and needs his approval. No face reference in this round. ROUND 1 (output\lora_batra_design, B1 to B36): he liked B5, B11 (without the tree), B22, B28, B36. Through the question tool (option labels are Claude's wording, his selections) he then chose: BLACK sash as written, KEEP the ivory cross-strap (a new garment, not in the 2026-10-02 lock), FOREARM sleeves, BROWN boots (replacing the written black). Round 2 (output\lora_batra_design_r2) applies those.
